title: Deep threads stay readable: 'continue this thread →' pages beyond five levels, and a collapse/expand toggle on every comment
how_to_read: Each attempt is one line and a `details` filename in this same directory. Open a detail file ONLY when this index points you at one -- the summaries are here so you do not have to. `caused_by` is what sent the stage back; `changed` is what the attempt then touched, counted by kind. Several attempts in a row that were caused by the same stage and changed no `src` is a loop, not progress.

open.issue: No page (/, /reports/<slug>, a branch page) nests a comment more than five levels deep: missing
A depth-5 comment whose replies are cut shows a 'continue this thread →' link to /reports/<slug>/comments/<id>: missing

GET /reports/{slug}/comments/{id} opens that branch on its own page, with a link back to the full report and reply forms for a signed-in reader; hidden or unknown report, bad id or pruned id → the same 404: missing
A reply posted below the cap is answered 303 to the branch page that shows it (#comment-<id>), and to /reports/<slug>#comments if the re-read fails: missing
Every comment with shown replies has a collapse/expand toggle that, in a browser, hides and then shows everything beneath it, using /static/thread.js served from the site's own path: missing
Deep conversations stay readable on phones (the cut at five keeps a depth-5 comment body a usable width): missing
